_comment: Single source of truth for pricing copy and prices. Edit here, then run `node tools/build.mjs` to regenerate public/pricing/index.html. Nothing else should hardcode a price.
delivery: Everything is delivered as digital files. I don't sell prints, print packages, wall art, albums, or printed announcement cards, and I don't handle printing or shipping. Your photos are yours to print wherever you like.
booking: A date is reserved once we've agreed on it by email or Instagram message. Dates fill first-come, and autumn weekends around South Valley Park go earliest.

tiers.name: Session
tiers.summary: One hour, one location, about 20 edited photos.

tiers.summary: The full session, plus all three add-ons below.

addons.name: Graduation announcement card
